info.title: b10x Connectors hosted API
info.summary: The identity-authenticated hosted transport for the Connector wire contracts.
info.description: Six strict envelope endpoints (one closed connector-* wire contract each), public native-client discovery, a stateless MCP transport, and health probes. Every envelope is validated with closed field sets: an unknown field anywhere in a request is refused. The protocol field of each envelope pins the exact wire-contract identity; a different value is a different contract. Request and response examples in this document are validated against the server's own protocol types by the repository test suite.

servers.description: Deployments may mount the router under a base path; every path here is relative to that base.

get.summary: Discover this deployment's neutral Identity authority
get.description: Public native-client bootstrap metadata. The Connector deployment publishes the Identity origin it trusts; Identity remains relying-party neutral and does not publish a Connector URL.

200.description: The exact Identity origin and Connector audience.

503.description: This router was embedded without native-client discovery.

get.summary: Report whether the current person has connected a Claude Code subscription
get.description: Returns presence only. The stored credential is never listed or exported. Requires connectors.connections.self.

404.description: Subscription custody is disabled in this deployment.

put.summary: Replace the current person's Claude Code subscription credential
put.description: The value crosses this one request boundary and is committed only to the Connector-owned SecretStore. It is never logged or returned. Requires connectors.connections.self.

400.description: The bounded credential shape was refused.

delete.summary: Delete the current person's Claude Code subscription credential and revoke its leases

post.summary: Start a Claude Code subscription PKCE connection
post.description: Creates bounded single-use server-side PKCE state and returns only the provider authorization URL plus an opaque flow id. Requires connectors.connections.self.

post.summary: Complete a pending Claude Code subscription connection
post.description: Consumes the provider's one-use code#state manual result, verifies its state against the server-held browser flow, and uses the server-held PKCE verifier to store a refresh-capable credential in Connector custody. Requires connectors.connections.self.

400.description: The pending flow, code, or provider response was refused.

post.summary: Create an attempt-bounded lease over the current person's credential
post.description: Returns a short-lived capability, never the provider credential. The capability is bound to one exact Harness attempt, a lifetime no longer than one hour, and a finite use count. Requires connectors.credentials.lease.

401.description: Identity authority or lease policy was refused.

409.description: The person has no connected subscription credential.

post.summary: Redeem one bounded use directly into a Harness provider adapter
post.description: This internal credential boundary requires the lease capability as Bearer authentication and the exact bound attempt id. It consumes one use and returns a non-cacheable OAuth bearer value. It does not accept an Identity token.

200.description: The current provider credential for immediate use; never persist it.

401.description: The capability, attempt binding, lifetime, or use count was refused.

post.summary: Issue one human-decided exact-input approval proof
post.description: Requires connectors.approvals.issue on a non-delegated human Identity token. Connectors re-describes the operation and seals the exact operation, Connection, description lease, canonical input digest, subject, issuer, and finite lifetime into a one-time proof. Realm is authentication context and is never carried by this request.

400.description: The bounded approval request was refused.

403.description: The verified human lacks approval authority.

409.description: The operation, Connection, or description lease is stale.

503.description: Identity or approval authority is unavailable.

post.summary: Search, describe, invoke, and control sessions over admitted Connector operations
post.description: One strict connector-operation envelope per request; the closed method set is search, describe, invoke, session_status, session_terminate, session_reconcile, and session_signal. Frames above 524288 bytes are refused. Scopes: connectors.catalog.read admits search and describe; connectors.invoke admits invoke and every session method.

post.description: Speaks MCP revisions 2025-03-26 and 2025-06-18 with no SSE stream, no session id, and no batching. The static toolset is exactly three meta-tools: tool_search, tool_describe, and tool_invoke; every call funnels through the same admission the envelope endpoints use, so this transport adds zero policy of its own.

200.description: One JSON-RPC response; tool-level refusals are execution results with isError true and the envelope protocol's own error code in structuredContent.

error.message: method not found

202.description: A notification or client-to-server response frame was acknowledged without a body.

400.description: The frame is not one JSON-RPC 2.0 request object.

error.message: the frame is not JSON

401.description: The bearer is verified once, before any JSON-RPC processing.

get.description: Serves the committed OpenAPI 3.1 contract verbatim, unauthenticated, with a content-hash ETag. The document is immutable per build.

200.description: The complete machine-readable contract for this server.

ETag.description: Quoted lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact served bytes.

identityAccessToken.description: Identity-issued access token, verified on every request against the audience urn:b10x:connectors. Scopes: connectors.catalog.read (operation search/describe, catalog reads, datasource reads, connection reads), connectors.invoke (operation invocation and session control), connectors.approvals.issue (human exact-input approval issuance), connectors.connections.manage (connection activation, materialization, and session creation), connectors.connections.self (self-service connections and subscription custody), connectors.credentials.lease (attempt-bounded provider credential leases), connectors.events.read (operator event reads), connectors.events.self (self-service Slack event reads).

subscriptionLease.description: Short-lived, finite-use, attempt-bound capability issued by the subscription lease endpoint. It is not an Identity token and must never be persisted.

code.description: The complete one-use code#state value shown by the provider's manual callback. Connectors verifies the returned state before exchanging the code component.

credential.description: Use immediately as the provider OAuth bearer and discard.

method.description: Served methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call. notifications/* frames are acknowledged without a body. Anything else answers JSON-RPC -32601.

mcp.request.description: One single-message JSON-RPC 2.0 request. No SSE stream, no session id, no batching.

mcp.response.description: One JSON-RPC 2.0 response carrying exactly one of result or error.

errorBody.description: Transport-level identity refusal, before any envelope processing.
